seoTitle: SoftwareApplication Schema Generator (Mobile, Web App, Free Price 0)
metaDescription: Build SoftwareApplication, MobileApplication or WebApplication JSON-LD with category, operating system, price and rating.
intro: Generates app markup with Google's application categories, operating system, price (0 for free apps) and an aggregate rating or review.
why:
Google requires a name, a price and either a rating or a review for software app results. The tool checks the category against the list in Google's documentation, writes free apps as price 0 with a currency, and warns when no rating or review is present.

Pick SoftwareApplication, MobileApplication or WebApplication as the type. Ratings must be genuine and shown on the page.
howTo: Enter price and currency; use 0 for a free app.
Add ratingValue and ratingCount, then copy the script.

faq.a: The ones Google lists, from GameApplication to ReferenceApplication. Others trigger a warning.

faq.q: How is a free app written?
faq.a: As an offer with price 0 and a currency.

faq.q: Do I need both rating and review?
faq.a: One of them is enough for Google.

faq.q: Which operating systems can I list?
faq.a: Free text such as Android 10+, iOS 16+.
